title: Grateful Dead Live at University Auditorium, University of Arizona on 1969-04-11
source: Master Soundboard Cassette >  cass >  dat > cd

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of the 1969 Tucson show is quiet and uneven but still captures a powerful Dark Star, St. Stephen, The Eleven and a monster “It’s a Sin.”
ai_review.review: The set delivers several classic moments – Dark Star, St. Stephen (though recorded at low level), The Eleven and an inspired Pig Pen‑driven “It’s a Sin” – but the mix is inconsistent, with the first half clearer than the second and occasional chaotic drumming. Jerry’s guitar work is repeatedly praised as “monster,” while Phil’s rig gets a nod, making the performance worthwhile despite the technical shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between high praise for musical moments and criticism of low volume/uneven sound; overall rating hovers just above average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low recording levels on Dark Star & St. Stephen, generally quiet mix, tape hiss present, second half noticeably worse with chaotic drumming; some listeners report being able to boost volume in post‑processing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First half clearer, second half considered the stronger performance musically despite poorer sound; transitions not specifically noted.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly called a monster electric‑guitar player with legendary Fender tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned positively regarding his rig, though no specific playing details.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pig Pen’s harmonica on “It’s a Sin” praised; no direct keyboard comments.
band_member_comments.Drums: Chaotic drumming noted in the second half.
